why: Fixes tests/test_live_replay_parity_ml.py, red on main since #25255 (5005a687), and the production fidelity bug behind it (PI-20261113-TFZXAKEK-0002, assigned by AM-ML 2026-11-13 16:03Z). Root cause, verified: live_replay_parity_ml.served_epoch() is the git commit time of the last change to ml/served/ENTRY_SERVED.json; in a SHALLOW clone git reports the graft root instead, so the epoch lands after the fixture's fixed 2026-11-10 bars and every bar reads 'decided by the previous served artifact' -> could_not_check. #25255's PR checkout was deep enough (green 13:22Z); main's depth-1 checkout was not. The live-replay-parity workflow's depth-1 checkout had the same blind spot in production. Fix: (1) served_epoch_unknown_reason() detects a shallow-graft-root answer and the analyser reports could_not_check with that reason instead of classifying bars against a clone-depth artifact; (2) the workflow checks out full blobless history (fetch-depth 0, filter blob:none) so production reads the real epoch; (3) the test pins the served epoch to the real repoint (425373a430, #23888, 2026-11-06 18:34:31Z) and adds a real-git test of the shallow detector. No assertion weakened, nothing skipped. No automerge request: AM-ML merges on green. Revert: git revert.
